title: CO2 supply empty or tank valve closed
symptoms: Flat drinks on every valve; no fizz; CO2 gauge needle in the red zone
root_cause: The CO2 cylinder ran empty or its valve was left closed after a tank swap, so the carbonator cannot carbonate the water
fix_steps: Check that the CO2 cylinder valve is fully open (turn counter-clockwise)|Look at the cylinder gauge; if the needle is in the red zone, swap to a full cylinder|Pour a test drink from each valve and check the fizz

title: Bag-in-box empty or disconnected
symptoms: One flavor watery or clear; syrup line sputtering; flavor tastes like soda water
root_cause: The syrup bag for that flavor is empty or its connector came off, so only carbonated water pours
fix_steps: Find the bag-in-box for the affected flavor on the syrup rack|If the bag is empty, replace it with a new bag of the same flavor and click the connector on firmly|Pour from that valve until syrup flows steadily

title: Carbonator pump failure
symptoms: Flat or watery drinks on all valves even with a full CO2 tank; carbonator pump runs constantly or hums; motor hot to the touch
root_cause: The carbonator pump is not pushing water into the carbonator tank at full pressure, so water passes through under-carbonated
fix_steps: Shut off water and CO2 to the carbonator and unplug the unit|Remove the carbonator pump motor assembly|Install a new carbonator pump motor assembly|Restore water then CO2, purge the carbonator relief valve, and test carbonation

title: Cold plate running warm
symptoms: Drinks warm or lukewarm; ice melting fast; drinks foaming at the nozzle
root_cause: Ice has bridged above the cold plate or the drain is clogged and meltwater pools, so no ice touches the cold plate
fix_steps: Empty and break up the ice in the bin so ice rests on the cold plate|Clear the ice bin drain and replace the drain tube if cracked|Refill the bin and check that drinks pour at 40 degrees F or colder

title: Ice not dispensing
symptoms: No ice comes out of the chute; ice clumped into a block; agitator not turning; grinding noise
root_cause: The ice agitator motor failed or the chute gate jammed, usually with clumped ice in hot weather
fix_steps: Unplug the unit and empty the ice bin|Inspect the agitator and chute gate for clumped ice and free them|Replace the ice agitator motor if it does not turn when powered|Refill with fresh ice and test dispensing

title: Valve leaking or nozzle dripping
symptoms: Drips from a nozzle after pouring; puddle on the drip tray or counter; valve keeps pouring after release
root_cause: A worn or defective valve seal or O-ring lets water or syrup past the closed valve
fix_steps: Shut off water and syrup to the affected valve|Remove the valve and nozzle|Replace the valve seals and O-rings|Reinstall, restore supply, and watch for drips for two minutes

title: Brix out of calibration
symptoms: One flavor tastes watery or too sweet; customers complain about taste
root_cause: Syrup or water flow on that valve has drifted away from the set syrup-to-water ratio
fix_steps: Fit a syrup separator to the valve|Measure syrup and water flows into a brix cup|Adjust the syrup flow control until the ratio matches the manual|Remove the separator and taste-test

title: Clogged or dirty nozzle
symptoms: Weak or uneven stream; drink sprays sideways; slime or mold visible on the nozzle
root_cause: Syrup residue and mold build up in the nozzle and diffuser when daily cleaning is skipped
fix_steps: Pull off the nozzle and diffuser by hand|Soak them in warm water with sanitizer for 10 minutes, then rinse|Wipe the underside of the valve and push the nozzle back on

title: Screen dark (power or breaker)
symptoms: Screen is black; nothing lights up; unit silent
root_cause: The unit is unplugged, its power strip is switched off, or the circuit breaker tripped
fix_steps: Check that the unit's plug is firmly in the outlet|Check the breaker for the dispenser circuit and reset it once if tripped|If the breaker trips again, stop and call for service

title: Low CO2 (error E-21)
symptoms: Screen shows E-21; flat drinks
root_cause: The CO2 cylinder is empty or its valve is closed
fix_steps: Check that the CO2 cylinder valve is fully open|If the gauge needle is in the red zone, swap to a full cylinder|Clear the E-21 alert on the screen and pour a test drink

title: Valve solenoid fault (error E-34)
symptoms: Screen shows E-34; one flavor will not pour; clicking sound
root_cause: A valve solenoid coil failed or its connector worked loose
fix_steps: Power down the unit|Open the front service panel and check the solenoid connector for the affected valve|Replace the valve solenoid coil|Power up and test-pour

title: Nozzle or valve leaking
symptoms: Drips under the nozzle cluster; puddle in the drip tray; E-50 drip tray full
root_cause: A worn or defective valve seal or O-ring in the nozzle cluster
fix_steps: Power down and shut off water and syrup|Remove the nozzle cluster|Replace the valve seals and O-rings|Reassemble and watch for drips for two minutes

title: Flavor sold out (error E-12)
symptoms: Screen shows a flavor sold out; E-12; one flavor greyed out
root_cause: The bag-in-box for that flavor is empty or disconnected
fix_steps: Find the bag-in-box for the flavor shown on screen|Replace the empty bag with a new one of the same flavor and click the connector on|Pour that flavor until syrup flows and the E-12 alert clears

title: Refrigeration running warm (error E-40)
symptoms: Screen shows E-40; warm drinks; loud fan or no fan noise
root_cause: The condenser fan failed or the condenser coils are clogged with dust, worst in hot weather
fix_steps: Power down the unit|Clean the condenser coils|Replace the condenser fan motor if it does not spin|Power up and confirm drinks drop to 40 degrees F or colder within 30 minutes

title: Pilot will not stay lit
symptoms: Pilot goes out when the gas knob is released; fryer won't heat; faint gas smell while relighting
root_cause: The thermocouple is worn, so the gas safety valve closes as soon as the knob is released
fix_steps: Turn the gas control knob off and let the fryer cool|Replace the pilot thermocouple|Relight the pilot following the lighting instructions and hold the knob for 60 seconds|Confirm the pilot stays lit and the burners fire

title: Slow heat recovery
symptoms: Oil takes too long to heat; fries come out soggy or pale; long recovery after dropping baskets
root_cause: The thermostat probe reads low or is out of calibration, so the burners cycle off early
fix_steps: Check oil temperature with a reference thermometer|Calibrate the thermostat probe|Replace the probe if it reads more than 10 degrees F off|Run a heat-up test from 300 to 350 degrees F

title: Fryer will not start (power)
symptoms: Display dark; electronic ignition doesn't click; fryer completely dead
root_cause: The fryer was unplugged (often after cleaning) or its breaker tripped
fix_steps: Check that the fryer's plug is pushed fully into the outlet|Check the breaker for the fryer circuit and reset it once if tripped|If the breaker trips again, stop and call for service

title: High-limit tripped
symptoms: Fryer shut itself off and won't relight; oil was smoking before it stopped
root_cause: The thermostat stuck on and the oil overheated past 450 degrees F, so the high-limit switch cut the gas
fix_steps: Let the oil cool completely|Test the high-limit switch and replace it if it does not reset|Replace the thermostat probe that stuck on|Run a watched heat-up and confirm the burners cycle off at the set point

title: Cold spots on griddle
symptoms: Uneven cooking; one zone much cooler; patties raw in one area of the plate
root_cause: A burner orifice is partly clogged with grease, so one burner runs a small flame
fix_steps: Turn off the gas and let the griddle cool|Remove and clean the burner orifices; replace any that are damaged|Check that the flame is even and blue on every burner|Check plate temperature in each zone with a surface thermometer

title: Burner will not ignite
symptoms: One section won't light; clicking with no flame
root_cause: The spark igniter for that burner is cracked or out of position
fix_steps: Turn off the gas to the griddle|Replace the spark igniter for that burner|Test ignition three times

title: Thermostat not holding temperature
symptoms: Griddle runs much hotter or cooler than the dial setting
root_cause: The thermostat bulb is damaged or out of calibration
fix_steps: Measure surface temperature at dial settings of 300 and 350 degrees F|Calibrate the thermostat|Replace the thermostat if it can't be calibrated

title: Low ice: clogged air filter
symptoms: Ice bin slow to fill; machine runs constantly; warm air at the front grille
root_cause: The removable front air filter is clogged with grease and dust, so the condenser overheats
fix_steps: Pull the air filter out of the front grille (no tools needed)|Rinse it in warm soapy water, dry it, and slide it back in|Check that the bin is filling again after a few hours

title: Low ice: scale buildup
symptoms: Little ice; small, thin, or cloudy cubes; long freeze cycles; error E-3
root_cause: Mineral scale on the evaporator and water system slows freezing; worst in summer under heavy load
fix_steps: Run the descaling cycle with ice machine scale remover|Clean the condenser coil|Sanitize the bin and water trough|Confirm the harvest cycle time is back in range

title: No ice: water inlet valve
symptoms: Machine runs but makes no ice; water trough empty; error E-1
root_cause: The water inlet valve failed or its screen is blocked
fix_steps: Confirm the water supply valve is open|Clean the inlet valve screen|Replace the water inlet valve if no water flows when it is energized|Run a full freeze and harvest cycle

title: Cooler warm: iced evaporator
symptoms: Walk-in above 41 degrees F; ice on the evaporator coil inside; weak airflow from the inside unit
root_cause: The defrost timer failed, so ice builds on the evaporator and blocks airflow; worst in humid summer weather
fix_steps: Move at-risk food to another cooler and log temperatures|Run a manual defrost and clear the ice|Replace the defrost timer|Confirm box temperature returns to 35-38 degrees F

title: Door not closing fully
symptoms: Door pops open or doesn't seal; frost around the door frame; box slowly warming
root_cause: Something blocks the door or strip curtain, or the door was left ajar
fix_steps: Check that nothing (boxes, carts, floor mats) blocks the door|Push the door fully closed and check that it latches|Check the strip curtain hangs straight|If the gasket is torn, call for service

title: Condenser fan failed
symptoms: Walk-in warming; outdoor condensing unit loud or silent; condenser hot
root_cause: The condenser fan motor or its capacitor failed, so the condensing unit overheats and trips
fix_steps: Turn off power to the condensing unit|Test the fan capacitor and motor|Replace the condenser fan motor or capacitor|Restore power and confirm head pressure and box temperature

title: Weak airflow: dirty return filter
symptoms: Weak air from the vents; dining room stuffy; unit runs constantly
root_cause: The return-air filter is clogged
fix_steps: Turn the thermostat to Off|Open the return-air grille (latches, no tools) and slide out the filter|Slide in a new filter of the same size|Turn the thermostat back on and check the airflow

title: Not cooling: failed capacitor or low refrigerant
symptoms: Warm air from the vents; outdoor unit humming but compressor not running; restaurant hot
root_cause: The compressor run capacitor failed (common in summer heat) or refrigerant is low from a leak
fix_steps: Turn off power at the rooftop disconnect|Test and replace the compressor run capacitor|Check refrigerant pressures; leak-check and recharge if low|Restore power and confirm supply air is 15-20 degrees F colder than return air

title: Thermostat blank
symptoms: Thermostat screen blank; can't change the temperature; no heating or cooling
root_cause: The thermostat batteries are dead or the HVAC breaker tripped
fix_steps: Replace the thermostat batteries (AA, behind the front cover)|Check the HVAC breaker and reset it once if tripped|If the screen stays blank, call for service

title: Condenser fan motor failed
symptoms: Grinding noise from the roof unit; condenser fan not spinning; cooling cuts out on hot afternoons
root_cause: The condenser fan motor bearings are worn
fix_steps: Turn off power at the rooftop disconnect|Replace the condenser fan motor and capacitor|Restore power and check amperage
